_doc: D3b (MIGRATION-PLAN §3r): the Owner Actions copy. Five data nodes change; the replay marker takes the Q17 (a) form; the webhook moves to a test path behind Access.
name: MIG COPY — Owner Actions (D11)

Release Handoff Lock.query: UPDATE salon.conversations SET stage = 'new', last_intent = '' WHERE id = $1 RETURNING @@shape(conversations)@@

Record Owner Action Processed.query: INSERT INTO salon.processed_messages (message_id, sender_key, channel, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'owner:dashboard', 'owner', $2::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO UPDATE SET message_id = EXCLUDED.message_id RETURNING @@shape(processed_messages)@@
